summary: fractal-ui renders Markdown backtick spans as token-styled inline code on every transcript Markdown surface: answers, mail titles, prompts, delivered system text, typed events, thinking, Embrace agent questions and Markdown previews; notices, status and usage rows stay plain text

replay.detail: Client-only rendering change; no runtime replay change.

compatibility.detail: Client-only change; conversation items and their text are unchanged, only their presentation.

manual.detail: No deployed installation action required; fractal-web picks the change up on its next build.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
